podcast.body: In 2009, this debut single by Christian electro-pop artist Adam Young, known as Owl City, reached number one on the Hot 100 in America. Unlike the Arctic Monkeys, the introverted Adam Young actively curated his Myspace profile, using it to develop a fanbase that ultimately led to his signing with major label Universal Republic. "Adam Young, who called himself Owl City, reached number one on the Hot 100 with his own debut single Fireflies."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
srcs.episode: Ride ’til I Can’t No More Edition Part 2
